items.title: Roleplay Skins
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Step into any role with the Roleplay Skins pack! Become a brave firefighter, sneaky prisoner, heroic police officer, and more!

- Perfect for roleplaying with friends
- 10 Roleplay Skins

items.title: Purple Moon Teens
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Embrace the night and shine like the amethyst moon in enchanting shades of purple.
-12 skins
-perfect for roleplay

items.title: Security Furniture
items.creator: Street Studios
items.description:
DEFEND YOURSELF! Explore your giant security base and get lots of furniture for your decoration and security! Protect yourself from intruders with lots of security cameras, laser guns and bunker doors.

- Police car and Drone
- Bunker and automatic farms
- Lots of variety of security gates and weapons
- Skins included

items.title: Owls Add-On
items.creator: Noxcrew
items.description:
Bring owls into your survival world with the Owls Add-On!

- Find 9 different breeds of Owls!
- Give them tools and equipment that can make them battle pets, crafting assistants, or even help you fly!

items.title: Emo Demons
items.creator: Loose Screw
items.description:
Unleash your dark side with the Emo Demons Skins! Featuring a collection of brooding, sinister demon designs, this pack brings the perfect blend of gothic style and otherworldly power to your game. Transform into a demon with a story to tell and rule the shadows!

- Total of 10 skins
- Great for roleplay!
- By Loose Screw

items.title: Vampire Teens
items.creator: Loose Screw
items.description:
Join the high society of vampires enrolled in high school. You don't know who is friend or foe with these cool and mysterious vampires!

- Total of 10 stylish vampire teen skins
- Great for roleplay and hanging out!
- By Loose Screw

items.title: BUTTERFLY Add-On
items.creator: Lothiredon
items.description:
Embrace nature with this BUTTERFLY Add-On!

+ 20 EPIC butterflies!
+ Butterfly greenhouse structures!
+ MORE flowers and gardening!

In partnership with the British Butterfly Conservation.

items.title: Kittys
items.creator: Endorah
items.description:
Put on your most stylish clothes and get ready with your Kittys skins! Play with your friends with these cute skins and be the coolest!

+ 10 skins!
+ Perfect for roleplay!
+ Have Fun!
By Endorah

items.title: Gladiator Village
items.creator: Endorah
items.description:
Discover the Roman village of the gladiators! Multiple temples and a real gladiator arena to have fun with your friends!

-Roman dwellings
-Gladiator arena
-perfect for survival

By Endorah

items.title: Dark Voids
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Do you dare to become a dark void, glowing with the energy of the darkness beneath your skin? Embrace their power and unravel the ancient secrets hidden within the darkness!

+Dark Voids skins!
+Amazing for roleplay!

items.title: Master Knights
items.creator: Skilendarz
items.description:
Chivalry meets cyber! This pack fuses medieval valor with neon tech, delivering high-powered warriors from a digital age. From luminous lances to radiant visors, these champions light up any battlefield in style.

+ 10 glowing neon skins!
+ Perfect for sci-fi and futuristic fantasy roleplay!
+ Join the order and become a Master Knight!

items.title: Aesthetic Teens
items.creator: Verart
items.description:
Dress up and express your vibe!
Explore 70 stylish skins with soft tones and trendy looks.

7 unique aesthetic designs
Tons of cozy variants
Perfect for fashion-forward players

— By Verart

items.title: Extreme Trampoline Park
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
This map is more than a huge trampoline park! Jump around on obstacles, play games, try the parkour, or drive in a vehicle! This world has endless activities for you!

- Working car, helicopter, cable car ride, and trampolines! 
- Add even more vehicles or furniture yourself!
- Beautiful landscape near spawn!
- Licensed by Fun Creators and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Pro Gamers
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Level up your style with these elite gamer teens. Pulling off cool streetwear, these skins are built for streaming, clutch plays, and showing off your skill.

- 8 Pro Gamers skins
By Underblocks!

items.title: Ender VS Souls
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
Pick your side and jump straight into battle! Become the ultimate ENDER warrior, or become the master of SOULS. Use your magic fire powers and impress everyone with your fierce new mysterious look!

+ 24 Skins!
+ Perfect for Roleplaying!

items.title: Combat Actions + Weapons Add-On
items.creator: Tsunami Studios
items.description: This Add-On adds RPG style combat moves or (Actions) to your game. We've got... double jumps, rolls, slides, dodges and attack combos. And the weapons? Try 100 unique custom weapons of all kinds. Sci-Fi laser blasters? Yep. Spears, flails, daggers, axes and so on? You got it. Overpowered, mythical and completely ridiculous weapons? You better believe it...

items.title: Froggy Teens
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Hop into fun and fashion with these frog-tastic skins! Take your cuteness leaps and bounds above the rest!

- 8 unique skins!
- Perfect for fun with friends!

By Jingles & Pathway Studios

items.title: Cozy Pine Mansion
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Breathtaking property in the woods. Flanking the main house; a tennis court, soccer field and a gorgeous infinity pool overlooking the sea. The property has an apiary, a barn, a greenhouse and a farm with a variety of crops available attached to a state of the art storage building. There are luxury vehicles and a helicopter available on site.

Come experience the comfort.

items.title: Primal Overworld 1.3
items.creator: Cyclone
items.description:
MEANINGFUL UPDATE!
RELEASE DATE: JUNE 16th
Explore the new Dust Frontier biome, a harsh badland, filled with towering cliffs, narrow canyons, and endless dusty ravines, where only the toughest adventurers survive.
+ 1 new Dust Frontier biome
+ 5 new Clans and Bosses
+ 9 new Dinosaurs
+ New bounty system with 25 quests
items.changelog:
Introducing the Dust and Dominion update!
+ 1 new Dust Frontier biome
+ 5 new Clans and Bosses
+ 9 new Dinosaurs
+ New bounty system with 25 quests
+ 8 new Weapons and 1 new Armor set
+ 17 new structure types

items.title: FIRE TEENS
items.creator: Aurrora
items.description: Light a blaze and join your next world in style! These skins are to hot to handle! 5 Fiery teen skins for you to choose from.

items.title: Shadow Enders
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
From deep within the shadows of the End's obsidian towers, purple eyes look out, seeing all. Lurk with them as one of the mysterious entities!

- 8 skins!
- By Magefall

items.title: Iconic Fashion
items.creator: Meraki
items.description:
The trendsetting teens are back to bring you more iconic styles and outfits. Can you match their iconic fashion?

- 12 stylish teen skins

by Meraki

items.title: Ice Kings
items.creator: 2-Tail Productions
items.description:
Seize the frozen throne with the Ice Kings skin pack! 12 legendary rulers, each forged by the icy wilderness, await their destiny. Will you lead with frost and fury or vanish into the cold?

+ 12 ice-themed skins
+ Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Neon Heroes
items.creator: 2-Tail Productions
items.description:
Glow like a true hero! Pick from 12 electrifying neon-themed skins and shine bright as you save the day in style. Adventure has never looked this bold!

+ 12 vibrant skins
+ Perfect for roleplay!
